summary: Phase 6 — Agentic Workflows + Compliance/Audit explorer tested end-to-end (backend 20/20 pytest pass + UI flows). All 17 requested checks PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_workflows.py /api/workflows/runs/{run_id}/* endpoints are global (no tenant in path) but properly guarded via _scope() — keep this consistent.

Approve endpoint runs the executor only AFTER human approval (correct HITL semantics); reject sets the entire run to rejected (not just the step) — confirm this is desired vs allowing re-approval flow.
Audit explorer endpoint reuses `_scope` correctly — wrong-tenant event fetch returns 403 (before 404 lookup), which is fine but slightly leaks 'institution exists' info; acceptable for an admin tool.
Compliance.jsx Select uses sentinel value '__all__' to avoid empty-value bug in shadcn — good. No issues.
